problemStatement.formal: For any C¹ curve γ : ℝ → ℝ × ℝ on [a, b] with line spacing d > 0, E[crossings] = 2 * arcLength(γ) / (π * d)
problemStatement.plain: Buffon-Barbier theorem for smooth curves: the expected crossing count depends only on arc length.
whyMatters: Bridges geometric probability and integral geometry
